The correction branch saves an episode only when the scripted expert plan is valid and env.get_wrapper_attr('is_task_success')() holds (review-source-3), and the card's training_scope is training review only. Registration does not certify quality, successful collection or performance. loader_connection_supported=true: --dataset-root is required and --data-version-id is documented as the label for the consumption witness whose identity is recomputed from loaded bytes (review-source-1). In the checkout, main resolves the root into DatasetConfig.root (train.py:1059-1064,1135-1144); the patched make_dataset sets part_cfg.dataset.root and repo_id and calls LeRobot's original make_dataset (train.py:755-777), then wraps the result in _AliasedLeRobotDataset(dataset_root=root) whose __getitem__ reads the base dataset sample before emitting the consumption marker (train.py:227-229). The marker's identity is dataset_bytes_identity(root), a sha256 over the sorted relative-path/file-sha256 manifest of the actual root (train.py:68-88,210-211), not an argv or config constant; samples_read increments per real read (train.py:212-225). For mixtures, an exposure audit counts samples yielded by the DataLoader after collation and before policy.update (train.py:592-685,843-863). Caveats: TRAIN_DATA_SETTING is the module constant 'random'; no training run has consumed this dataset yet, so there is no batch-level exposure measurement for it; and the trainer's all-files identity recipe should be confirmed to equal the registered identity 05ddb4d51a42f64e512155d973de4b3a0128c0d563d56fd330b975009ffa97fa on first read. sources_supported=true: producer evidence 1b7917f95c9741429fd9ec77e5d991a8 is a sealed rc=0 native collect log that found the dataset beside the command; profile evidence f5921c966047433fab92aa41a7feb49b is a CPU native diagnostic with scope full, 20/20 episodes checked, 1480 parquet frames, 60 videos present and 60 decoded, no issues, and a 20-entry per-episode manifest with parquet/mp4 sha256 and content_sha256; its identity matches the card. Count units, scope and episode file grouping are therefore observed. However, all 20 episodes carry source_family=null, source_instance=null, split=null, supervision=null and conditions={}; known_source_families is 0; parents is empty; the description's round_28 parent-policy provenance is model-declared with a redacted checkpoint path; and recipe is empty. manifest_observations_supported=false: the format/count/video-decode/scope observations are genuine, but the full source checks do not pass. There is no per-episode supervision or success certificate (the profile's own unchecked list includes expert labels and success), so the is_task_success save gate in review-source-3 is a source-level possible gate, not a per-episode runtime certificate. Parent grouping is absent, training-only status is only a path-level property (split null; training_scope requires_independent_registration_review), and no reversible recipe is supplied. This dataset is reviewed_not_consumed, so no actual training-batch exposure counter exists yet; a future consumption witness at the real DataLoader read is required before claiming exposure or benefit. profile_witness has no inspector field, so there is no inspector code to inspect.
